question: The soft, visible outer part of the ear, made of cartilage, is called the:

reasons.A: Wrong: the snail-shaped part of the inner ear, not visible from outside.
reasons.B: Correct: the visible outer part of the ear.
reasons.C: Wrong: the light-sensitive layer at the back of the eye.
reasons.D: Wrong: the opening at the centre of the eye.
